standards.title: PCAF Part A financed emissions, third edition 2025
standards.note: Executable scope is a bounded listed-company equity/corporate-debt EVIC helper. Other asset classes need their own methods. Avoided emissions are separate from the inventory.
standards.verification_scope: Official landing page and displayed PDF pages 41–42 reviewed for listed-company numerator and EVIC denominator. Not an exhaustive conformity audit.
standards.source_locator: Part A third edition, printed pages 41–42 (PDF pages 41–42, one-indexed)
